series: Your Sign at the Party: Extended
title: The party where your crush is
old_caption:
Your crush is at the party. Aries walks past six times. Scorpio hides behind a plant.
What's your move when the crush walks in?

series: Your Sign at the Party: Extended
title: The housewarming party
old_caption:
First place alone, and everyone shows up: a plant named Gerald, a portrait of Leo, a couch moved nine times.
What would your sign bring to the housewarming?

series: Your Sign at the Party: Extended
title: The engagement party (and you’re single)
old_caption:
An engagement party where the singles table turns into the fun table. Leo gives a toast nobody asked for, and it's lovely.
Who's at your singles table?

title: Leo.exe: How Are You, Really?
old_caption:
"Thriving!!" is easier to type than "honestly, tired."
You don't have to perform for the people who love you. Let one of them see the unpolished version this week.

title: Virgo.exe: Draft 14
old_caption:
Fourteen drafts for a two-word reply.
The first honest version is usually the kind one. Send it before the footnotes start. Save this for your next "sounds fun!"

title: Scorpio.exe: One Dry Text
old_caption:
One "ok" and the worst-case story writes itself.
When a text feels cold, ask before you go quiet. Most of the time they were just driving.

title: Gemini.exe: Subject Changed
old_caption:
"Can we talk about us?" and suddenly there's a dog video.
When it gets real, stay in the hard sentence one line longer. That's where the closeness is.

title: Aries.exe: Day 30
old_caption:
Day 1: hearts everywhere. Day 30: scrolling for someone new.
The slow part isn't the boring part, it's where things get real. Let it build.

title: Taurus.exe: Too Comfy
old_caption:
Staying because it's comfortable isn't the same as staying because you're happy.
Ask yourself which one it is, then have the honest talk.

title: Cancer.exe: Care Overload
old_caption:
Soup, a scarf, their dentist booked. And when they ask what you need: "no no, I'm fine!"
Let the people you love take care of you too.
